```artifact
Decision Table for Battery Alarm Logic

| Condition 1: Battery Presence | Condition 2: Chargeability | Condition 3: Remaining Battery Amount (minutes) | Action 1: Battery Failure Alarm | Action 2: Low Battery Alarm | Action 3: Critically Low Battery Alarm |
|------------------------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| Present                      | Chargeable               | >= 10                                          | OFF                          | OFF                       | OFF                                     |
| Present                      | Chargeable               | < 10                                           | OFF                          | OFF                       | ON                                      |
| Present                      | Unchargeable             | -                                             | ON                          | OFF                       | OFF                                     |
| Absent                       | -                         | -                                             | ON                          | OFF                       | OFF                                     |
| -                           | -                         | < 10                                           | ON                          | ON                       | OFF                                     |
| -                           | -                         | >= 10 & < 30                                 | OFF                         | ON                       | OFF                                     |
| -                           | -                         | >= 30                                          | OFF                         | OFF                      | OFF                                     |

Decision Table for GUI Battery ETA Calculation

| Condition 1: Sensor Data Availability | Condition 2: Historical Battery Amounts | Action: Compute Battery ETA |
|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| Available                            | Valid (non‑null)                      | Compute ETA as specified   |
| Available                            | Invalid or corrupted                  | Display error message      |
| Unavailable                         | -                                      | Display "Sensor data unavailable" |
```
